title: Modeling and simulating turbulent secondary flow in a streamwise-rotating channel with LLM-guided symbolic regression and physics-informed neural networks
summary: The authors report a newly derived closure for the secondary-flow covariance in streamwise-rotating channels. Compared candidate closures against published DNS statistics over five rotation conditions and evaluated the selected closures in the physics-informed simulation. Validation is computational against DNS; no independent physical experiment is reported.
ai_technology: LLM-guided symbolic regression generated candidate stress-closure equations; a physics-informed neural network then used the selected closure to simulate the flow.
organization: Department of Mechanical Engineering, University of Minnesota, Minneapolis, Minnesota, USA
